# Team | Hallwood Media Ventures

Primary/company page (Hallwood Media Ventures official site).

## Key findings
- **Neil Jacobson — Managing Partner.** "20-year veteran of the music business." Held positions at Interscope Geffen A&M (UMG); appointed **President of Geffen Records** Jan 2016 (until Jan 2020; oversaw signing of Darkroom Records / Billie Eilish). **Founded Hallwood Media in January 2020** — "an independent music management company exclusively focused on songwriters and producers." Has coordinated artist catalog sales totaling **>$150M**. Berklee College of Music; YPO member.
- **Todd Lowen — Managing Partner.** 22 years in finance/investment (Lehman Brothers, Barclays, Olivetree, Cantor Fitzgerald), focused on **SPACs**. "Moved on to focus entirely on HMV."
- **Chuck Ciongoli** — former **CFO of Universal Music Group**.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — primary/official company page (Hallwood Media Ventures).
- Establishes Hallwood's founder/Managing Partner = **Neil Jacobson** (ex-UMG Geffen President), and that Hallwood Media Ventures (HMV) is the investment arm (with Todd Lowen). Supports Q3 (CEO/founder identity + bio). Note: LinkedIn lists Jacobson as CEO of Hallwood Media; the company's own team page titles him Managing Partner.
